adjudication.rationale: In `app/models/embeddable_host.rb`, the `before_validation` callback strips any path (`self.host.sub!(/\/.*$/, '')`), so the validation regex’s optional path group `(\/.*)?` can never be exercised on the value that is actually validated/stored. This is a real inconsistency/redundancy in the diff (suggesting unclear definition of what `host` should contain), but it doesn’t introduce broken behavior since the stored/validated value won’t include a path anyway.
